Share your passion for books
Do you like reading for your life? Do you like to dive into incredible books? And you love sharing your passion for books with other reading enthusiasts? Then apply for an apprenticeship as a bookseller at Orell Füssli. We love books as much as you do. In addition, Orell Füssli is a place where employees feel comfortable, where they enjoy working well together and achieve more together. During your apprenticeship, you get to know the book trade from the ground up.
We look forward to welcoming you on 1 August 2027 in one of our Branch Region Bern / Central Switzerland.
Your main tasks:

• Competent advice to customers

• Recommendation of books and new publications

• Receiving orders and handling them

• Various work on the computer and in our goods management system

• Presentation of books and non-books
Your profile:

• Good secondary education

• High service orientation, sociability, attention and curiosity

• Excellent knowledge of German and enjoyment of foreign languages

• Passionate about books and reading

• Passion for media and current affairs
Our offer:

• Varied training in different departments

• Collaborative and appreciative corporate culture

• Generous holiday regime

• Versatile discount offer

• Central location with good public transport connections

We look forward to your online application. Please send us this including motivation letter, CV, complete school reports and a short text about your favorite book. See you soon.

Tu aimes lire pour ta vie ? Vous aimez plonger dans des livres incroyables ? Et vous aimez partager votre passion pour les livres avec d'autres passionnés de lecture ? Demandez ensuite un apprentissage en tant que libraire à Orell Füssli. Nous aimons les livres autant que vous. En outre, Orell Füssli est un endroit où les employés se sentent à l'aise, où ils aiment bien travailler ensemble et obtenir plus ensemble. Pendant votre apprentissage, vous apprendrez à connaître le métier de livre depuis le début.
Nous sommes impatients de vous accueillir le 1er août 2027 dans l'une de nos agences Région Berne / Suisse centrale.
Vos principales tâches:

• Conseils appropriés aux clients

• Recommandation de livres et de nouvelles publications

• Réception et traitement des commandes

• Divers travaux sur l'ordinateur et dans notre système de gestion des biens

• Présentation des livres et autres livres
Votre profil:

• Bonne éducation secondaire

• Orientation de service élevée, sociabilité, attention et curiosité

• Excellente connaissance de l'allemand et de la jouissance des langues étrangères

• Passionné de livres et de lecture

• Passion pour les médias et les affaires courantes
Notre offre :

• Formation variée dans différents départements

• Culture d'entreprise collaborative et reconnaissante

• Un régime de vacances généreux

• Offre de réduction polyvalente

• Emplacement central avec bonnes liaisons de transport public

Nous nous réjouissons de votre candidature en ligne. Veuillez nous envoyer cette lettre de motivation, CV, rapports scolaires complets et un court texte sur votre livre préféré. A bientôt.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Ti vedi come ambasciatore per la lettura?

• Un sacco di storie e conoscenze

• Consulenza competente e stimolante ai nostri clienti

• Gestione del magazzino e ordinazione (ordine, remit, ricerca)

• Monitoraggio del mercato e della tendenza

• Collaborazione con raccolta e cassa

• Presentazione di libri e non libri

• Formazione completa come libreria o rivenditore con un'esperienza professionale approfondita

• Affinità al libro e ai media elettronici

• Personalità orientata al cliente e alle vendite con esperienza nel contatto con il cliente

• Interessi negli affari attuali

• Cultura aziendale collaborativa e apprezzativa

• Posizione centrale con buoni collegamenti di trasporto pubblico

descriptionByLocale.en:
Share your passion for books
Do you like reading for your life? Do you like to dive into incredible books? And you love sharing your passion for books with other reading enthusiasts? Then apply for an apprenticeship as a bookseller at Orell Füssli. We love books as much as you do. In addition, Orell Füssli is a place where employees feel comfortable, where they enjoy working well together and achieve more together. During your apprenticeship, you get to know the book trade from the ground up.
We look forward to welcoming you on 1 August 2027 in one of our branches in the Zurich / Northwest Switzerland region.
Your main tasks:

• Competent advice to customers

• Recommendation of books and new publications

• Receiving orders and handling them

• Various work on the computer and in our goods management system

• Presentation of books and non-books
Your profile:

• Good secondary education

• High service orientation, sociability, attention and curiosity

• Excellent knowledge of German and enjoyment of foreign languages

• Passionate about books and reading

• Passion for media and current affairs
Our offer:

• Varied training in different departments

• Collaborative and appreciative corporate culture

• Generous holiday regime

• Versatile discount offer

• Central location with good public transport connections

We look forward to your online application. Please send us this including motivation letter, CV, complete school reports and a short text about your favorite book. See you soon.
